body_markdown:
[Queens](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/queens-new-york-ny) is a popular borough with numerous neighborhoods and an impressive food scene. The borough boasts plenty of communities filled with restaurants and entertainment, with lower rental prices than areas in[Manhattan](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/manhattan-new-york-ny) . Renters can find the best Queens listings in November of 2026 under $2,950, which provide lower rents and quick commutes.


The median rent for a[New York City apartment](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) decreased to[$4,900](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/new-york-ny) this month. Now that we’re in deep fall season, renters must carefully weigh their options to find a cost-effective unit that meets their search criteria. The following Queens listings in November of 2026 under $2,950 offer stainless steel appliances, dishwashers, fitness centers, and more.


---


## Best Queens Listings in November of 2026 under $2,950


### [1. 60-80 Myrtle Avenue #3G](https://www.renthop.com/listings/60-80-myrtle-avenue/3g/75720080/show)


Neighborhood:[Ridgewood](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/ridgewood-new-york-ny)


Price: $2,750


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 20.77%


First up this month, is a spacious one bedroom apartment in Ridgewood, Queens. The bedroom can accommodate a Queen-size bed and the unit itself features a dishwasher, built-in microwave, stainless steel appliances, and deep bathtub. Prospective tenants will be able to access a gym, rooftop deck, package room, laundry in building, and the landlord allows pets.


### [2. 38-31 27th Street #1](https://www.renthop.com/listings/38-31-27th-st-1/1/75235376/show)


Neighborhood:[Long Island City](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/long-island-city-new-york-ny)


Price: $2,800


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 37.22%


Next up, don’t miss out on this large one bedroom apartment located close to Queens Plaza and the 39th Ave station in Long Island City. This unit features an open kitchen with dishwasher and King-sized bedroom with two closets. The unit is available for early November move ins but does not allow for pets.

### [3. 36-35 167th Street #6D](https://www.renthop.com/listings/36-35-167th-street/6d/77320549/show)


Neighborhood:[Flushing](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/flushing-new-york-ny)


Price: $2,350


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 17.54%


Next up, this Flushing one bedroom apartment has been recently renovated. This unit is located in an elevator building with easy street parking. The unit itself features a separate renovated kitchen, King-size bedroom, and best yet, heat and hot water are included in the rent.


### [4. 273 Burns Street #3FL](https://www.renthop.com/listings/273-burns-street/3fl/77338708/show)


Neighborhood:[Forest Hills](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/forest-hills-new-york-ny)


Price: $2,950


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 15.57%


This next unit on our list this month is located in Forest Hills Gardens in a townhouse. The one bedroom comes with a separately office space and an open kitchen. Tenants are responsible for paying for electricity and cooking gas. The landlord covers everything else.


### [5. 140-60 Beech Avenue #3K](https://www.renthop.com/listings/140-60-beech-avenue/3k/77213070/show)


Price: $2,399


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 15.82%


Last but not least, prospective tenants won’t want to miss out on this one bedroom apartment in Flushing, Queens. This unit has a spacious living area with plenty of natural light. The building itself is located close to local shops, restaurants, and public transportation.

## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These listings are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/) based on a few factors, including[layout](https://www.citysignal.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-nyc-apartment-types/) , apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain Queens listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days. If you are interested in scheduling a showing or have further questions, please make sure to submit an inquiry via the inquiry submission form located on the listing page.
